clock.tooltip: LocalHome system time - zone {zone} ({offset}). This is the clock the thermostat uses to pick each hour's slot.
clock.warning_timezone: The system's timezone differs from this device's. The system uses {server}, this device {device}. The hourly schedule follows the system clock, so every slot is applied {shift} off. If the system isn't set to the home's timezone, fix it on the board with sudo timedatectl set-timezone {zone} and restart LocalHome.
clock.warning_skew: The system clock is {minutes} min off compared to this device. Check that NTP sync is active on the board (timedatectl).
clock.update_available: LocalHome was updated: this page is still running the previous version.
clock.warning_unsynced: The board's clock isn't synchronized with the internet yet: until it is, the schedules may switch at the wrong time and the history is paused, so no reading is stored with the wrong time. It corrects itself as soon as the board reaches the internet (a few minutes after a power-on).

app.title: LocalHome
app.description: LocalHome: a house dashboard - heating, cooling, covers and power, on your own network.
app.offline: The board isn't answering: what you see was last updated at {time}.
app.empty_home_note: Sensors, switches and covers will show up here. Add your devices in the configuration panel.

sensors.stale_value_note: Last known value from {date} - no update in {time}
sensors.power_budget_note: {available} kW safe indefinitely · up to {trip} kW tolerated briefly · breaker trips quickly above that

climate.copy_zone_manual: “{to}” is held by hand: go back to the schedule on that zone first.
climate.mode_note: Shared by both zones - one central plant sends either hot or cold water to both valves.
climate.schedule_hint: Pick a temperature, then tap or drag across the hours; tap an hour again to clear it. It saves by itself.
climate.schedule_empty_heat: No winter schedule for this zone yet: while heating, the system stays off until you paint some hours.
climate.schedule_empty_cool: No summer schedule for this zone yet: while cooling, the system stays off until you paint some hours. The winter schedule is kept separately and comes back when you switch to heating.
climate.away_idle: Not in away mode - the normal schedule is running.
climate.tier_note_heat: Comfort: stops at the target and restarts {comfort}° below. Economy: restarts {economy}° below, to use less.
climate.tier_note_cool: Comfort: stops at the target and restarts {comfort}° above. Economy: restarts {economy}° above, to use less.
climate.copy_zone_confirm: Copy {from}'s {season} schedule onto {to}? {to}'s current {season} schedule is replaced.

climate_admin.intro: LocalHome is run from here without touching any file or code: the season, the apartment's Shelly devices, the operating settings, maintenance and the board's status.
climate_admin.broker_current: Broker {address}, no user: the one on the board itself, as in every usual installation. Changed by hand in config/mqtt_broker.json, then restart LocalHome.
climate_admin.broker_current_auth: Broker {address}, user {user}. Changed by hand in config/mqtt_broker.json, then restart LocalHome.
climate_admin.broker_down_hint: Check that mosquitto is running on that host: until it is, every Shelly reads as not reachable, whatever changes on the device.
climate_admin.zones_note: Two zones, each with a sensor and a valve: Shelly, simulated or, for the sensor, manual. A save needs a restart.
climate_admin.manual_mode_hint: Save and restart LocalHome: then a field to write the temperature appears below, in this card. You can also write it from the home page, on the zone's card.
climate_admin.cool_enabled_label: Can be cooled (uncheck for a condensation-prone zone)
climate_admin.save_success: Saved - restart LocalHome, then reload this page to verify.
climate_admin.mode_formula_heat: valves open below target, close above it
climate_admin.mode_formula_cool: valves open above target, close below it
climate_admin.zone_excluded_cool: Excluded from cooling ("Can be cooled" is off for this zone) - the thermostat doesn't touch this valve for temperature while cooling. Whatever state it's in below is either idle or driven by an interlock, not this zone's own control loop.
climate_admin.restart_pending: Saved, but not running yet - restart LocalHome and reload this page to see it live.
climate_admin.restart_confirm: Restart LocalHome now? It'll be back in a few seconds, but nothing here will respond until it is.
climate_admin.restart_in_progress: Restarting - this page will reload itself once it's back.
climate_admin.restart_unsupported_windows: Restarting from the browser isn't reliable on Windows - it can leave two processes fighting over the same port instead of actually restarting. Stop the process yourself (Ctrl+C in its terminal) and start it again, then reload this page - fine for developing on Windows, this is a non-issue on the Linux box you'd actually deploy to.
climate_admin.restart_timeout: Still not responding after 30 seconds - check the terminal LocalHome is running in for an error, then reload this page by hand.
climate_admin.updated_ago_normal_cadence: {time} ago - normal, this sensor reports on a change or roughly every 2h
climate_admin.not_reachable_battery: Not reachable yet - battery sensors only report on their own wake cycle or a button press. Press the button on the device for an immediate test report.
climate_admin.not_reachable_offline: Was reporting, now unreachable - check the device is powered and in range.
climate_admin.valve_not_reachable: Not reachable - check the device id and that it's powered and connected to the broker.
climate_admin.manual_no_value: No value yet: write one below.
climate_admin.first_report_after_boot: Waiting for its first report since the board came up
climate_admin.manual_box_note: It stands in for the sensor: the thermostat decides on this value at once. It stays until you change it or switch back to Shelly or Simulated.
climate_admin.extra_switches_note: Bathroom bypass valve and dehumidifier: two Shelly Plus 1 or 1 Gen3 with no zone and no sensor. Leave either blank if not wired.
climate_admin.extra_switches_note_more: If config.yaml's thermostat.interlocks/mode_switches already control one of these by a different name, update that entry to "Bathroom Bypass Valve"/"Dehumidifier": this panel always uses those exact names.
climate_admin.extra_sensor_note: A Shelly H&T Gen3 for the outdoor temperature and humidity, at the top of the home page and in the climate chart.
climate_admin.extra_sensor_note_more: Until the sensor is installed: with None the home page says “No sensor connected yet”; with Simulated it shows invented temperatures, marked as simulated - for trying things out.
climate_admin.diagnostic_note: Valves and extra switches are driven by hand from here: the thermostat and the safety rules stop. Turning it off hands control back at once, no restart.
climate_admin.diag_contact_note: Open and Close always mean the valve. A zone valve is normally closed: it opens when the Shelly's contact closes. The bypass is normally open: closing the contact closes it.
climate_admin.diagnostic_active_banner: Diagnostic mode is ON - the thermostat and all interlocks are hands-off. Every valve below only moves when you press its button.
climate_admin.diagnostic_confirm_on: Turn on diagnostic mode? The thermostat and all interlocks will stop controlling every valve until you turn this back off.
climate_admin.failsafe_active: Failsafe active: this sensor has been unreachable for {hours}h, past its threshold - its valve has been forced closed automatically. It will resume normal control the moment the sensor reports again, or use Diagnostic mode above to open it sooner.
climate_admin.failsafe_pending: Sensor unreachable for {hours}h - its valve stays as it was for now; it'll be forced closed automatically at {threshold}h unless the sensor recovers first.
climate_admin.system_note: What's wrong with the installation, and the board's, process's and history's numbers. Refreshed every 15 seconds.
climate_admin.system_note_more: Not of one zone: what didn't load and why, which devices aren't responding, whether the control and recording loops are running. The process, disk and history numbers tell a slow problem (memory growing, disk filling up) apart from normal.
climate_admin.system_problem_loop_stalled: {subject} loop stalled - check the service logs
climate_admin.system_skipped_note: Expected if you don't use those devices. If you did configure one, it's also listed under problems, and installs with the command shown.
climate_admin.system_skipped_line: package {package} is missing, install it with
climate_admin.vmc_note: Ventilation, through a Shelly 0/1-10V Dimmer Gen3: one id for on/off and speed. If the board stops, the VMC stays at the speed it had; in the app, power-on state "restore the last state" and no timer, so it starts again as it was after a black-out too (guide, section 19).
climate_admin.vmc_note_more: The night/day/boost buttons and the program are on the home page. Until the VMC is wired leave it Simulated: the controls still show and work, marked as simulated. With None it doesn't appear.
climate_admin.vmc_suggestion: Found in config.yaml ("{name}"). Save to manage it from here: after the restart the config.yaml entry for this device is ignored and the VMC shows up as "VMC".
climate_admin.vmc_offline_hint: mains-powered device: check the id, that it's powered and connected to the MQTT broker.
climate_admin.system_cpu_top_share: at full speed {share}% of the time
climate_admin.system_cpu_freq_capped: slowed down by heat ({max} GHz at most)
climate_admin.system_problem_cpu_throttled: CPU slowed down by heat ({subject}): check the board's ventilation and placement
climate_admin.system_problem_cpu_hot: CPU running hot ({subject}): check the board's airflow and placement
climate_admin.maint_note: Actions that delete data. Each one saves a full backup on the board first (config/backups), and asks you to type RESET to confirm.
climate_admin.maint_backup_note: Zones, panel devices, schedules and config.yaml in a .zip file. Credentials (device passwords and keys) are left out: they stay on the board only.
climate_admin.maint_backups_none: No automatic backup on the board yet.
climate_admin.maint_backups_some: Automatic backups on the board: {count}, the latest from {latest}.
climate_admin.maint_history_note: Empties the charts, the system-run statistics and Hours and consumption: each day's hours, the outdoor temperature and the heat meter's readings. Schedules and devices stay; a copy is saved on the board first.
climate_admin.maint_schedules_note: Empties every zone's weekly grid for both seasons and cancels away and diagnostic mode: valves close until you paint a new one.
climate_admin.maint_reset_note: Like a new installation: removes the panel's zones and devices, schedules, manual values, history (with the heat meter's readings) and caches, then restarts LocalHome. config.yaml, credentials and the MQTT broker stay.
climate_admin.maint_done_clear_history: History cleared ({rows} rows). Copy saved on the board: {backup}.
climate_admin.maint_done_clear_schedules: Schedules cleared. Backup saved on the board: {backup}.
climate_admin.maint_reset_done_restarting: Reset done, backup {backup} on the board. Restarting LocalHome…
climate_admin.maint_reset_done_manual: Reset done, backup {backup} on the board. Restart LocalHome by hand to finish it.
climate_admin.system_problem_wifi_weak: Weak Wi-Fi signal on {subject}: move the board closer to the router or use an extender
climate_admin.season_note: One season for the whole plant, each with its own schedule. Switching asks for confirmation.
climate_admin.season_note_more: One central unit sends hot or cold water to every zone, and it changes twice a year: that's why switching asks you to type the new season's name.
climate_admin.season_rule_from_home: switched on from the home page by whoever lives there
climate_admin.dehum_note: When it switches itself off, when it can be switched on, and how. Effective at once, no restart; the humidity is the first cooled zone's.
climate_admin.dehum_stop_help: The target humidity: below it, it switches off in any case. 50% is the usual value (comfort 40-60%).
climate_admin.dehum_start_help: Below it, it isn't switched on and the home page shows it off. At least 2 points above the stop, so it doesn't keep going on and off.
climate_admin.dehum_durations: Durations offered on the home page
climate_admin.dehum_until_target: Also "until the target", for at most
climate_admin.dehum_auto: Automatic: switches itself on above the start threshold
climate_admin.dehum_auto_help: Off by default: it draws a lot of power. On, it stops as always at the target, at the end of the window or when its hours for the day are used; switched off by hand from the home page, it waits 2 hours before switching itself on again.
climate_admin.dehum_rule: switched on from the home page for {ways}; {alone}; switches itself off below {stop}% humidity in {zone}, and isn't switched on below {start}%
climate_admin.dehum_rule_auto: by itself above {start}%, {window}, at most {max} hours a day
climate_admin.season_zone_excluded: {zone}: not cooled or scheduled (anti-condensation), valve always closed
climate_admin.season_zone_excluded_linked: {zone}: not cooled or scheduled (anti-condensation); its valve opens only with the {leader} on
climate_admin.season_confirm: Type {word} to confirm the season change:
climate_admin.season_done: Season changed: {season}. Valves, bypass and dehumidifier are already updated.
climate_admin.system_boots_note: How each session ended: 'interrupted' means the power went or the board hung, not a proper shutdown.
climate_admin.system_problem_clock_unsynced: The board's clock isn't synchronized: schedule slots may trigger at the wrong time (check its internet connection)
climate_admin.usage_note: A report only, for whoever looks after the plant: it drives nothing in the house. Month by month it puts the hours the plant was on beside the heat meter's kWh, to see how many kWh an hour of heating or cooling takes and to compare the years. The home's electricity meter has nothing to do with it: the climate comes from the building's central plant, and the heat meter counts it.
climate_admin.usage_legend_on: the hours with at least one zone open, counted once; below, each zone's. "–": LocalHome wasn't recording the valves yet; "hours of N days out of M": the other days have no record (before the installation, or the history cleared).
climate_admin.usage_legend_kwh: the month-end reading less the month before's (January: less the year before's December). "–": one of the two readings is missing. Below, the same month the year before and the difference. In the current month, an estimate: the hours so far at the average kWh per hour of the last months of the same kind, heat or cooling (up to 3, in the last year).
climate_admin.usage_legend_kwh_h: the month's usage divided by the hours on, only in months with all their hours recorded. In the total, the average over those months. Below, heat kWh per degree day: it takes out how cold it was, so different winters compare.
climate_admin.usage_legend_month: below, the outdoor mean and the degree days (DD): each day, 20 °C less its mean when below 20 °C. More DD, colder. They show when the outdoor sensor recorded every day of the month.
climate_admin.usage_edit_note: For each month the display's month-end reading: the total, which only grows (the meter keeps the last 15 months). If its display shows MWh, multiply by 1000. Under each box the month's usage shows: the reading less the month before's. For example: December 56,827, January 57,583 → January used 756 kWh. Leave a month you don't have empty; the first month typed has no usage.
climate_admin.usage_how_hours: LocalHome counts the hours: every 30 seconds it records whether each valve is open. The plant is on while at least one zone is, counted once; below, each zone's hours. In summer the bathrooms' valve also opens just for the dehumidifier's water: those hours count, as that water goes through the meter too.
climate_admin.usage_how_meter: You type the kWh, with "Meter values": for each month over, the total the display shows at the month's end (heating and, in summer, cooling). The display keeps the last 15 months: no need to read it on the very last day. A month's usage is its reading less the month before's.
climate_admin.usage_how_years: The years start from the one before LocalHome began recording: its December reading is what the first January's usage is worked out from. Each one opens and can be edited. Up to 6 are kept, this one and the 5 before; past that, on 1 January the oldest is deleted.
climate_admin.usage_how_csv: "Export CSV" downloads every month of every year - hours, readings, usage, kWh per hour, outdoor temperature - to open in a spreadsheet.
climate_admin.plant_settings_note: How the thermostat opens and closes the valves, and the VMC's speeds. The former apply after a restart, the speeds at once.
climate_admin.settings_note: They apply after LocalHome restarts, except where the field says otherwise. An empty field uses config.yaml or the default.
climate_admin.settings_defaults_confirm: Remove every setting made here and go back to config.yaml's?
climate_admin.setting_hysteresis_c_help: How far the room moves from the target before the valve restarts: below it heating, above it cooling. It stops as soon as the target is reached, as a radiant ceiling keeps heating or cooling for a while after. 0.5 is the step the H&Ts report in: less does nothing.
climate_admin.setting_economy_tolerance_c_help: Only for economy targets (heating below 20°, cooling from 26°): how much later the valve restarts, on the saving side. Comfort stays as it is; 0 = like comfort.
climate_admin.setting_tolerance_example: With these values: heating 20.5° (comfort) restarts at {c_heat}°, 19.5° (economy) at {e_heat}°; cooling 25.5° (comfort) at {c_cool}°, 26.5° (economy) at {e_cool}°. It always stops at the target.
climate_admin.setting_thermostat_poll_seconds_help: How often the thermostat checks the zones again with the sensors' latest readings. Your own changes - target, temporary change, schedule, season, away - act at once, without waiting. 60 is enough for a radiant system.
climate_admin.setting_sensor_failsafe_hours_help: If a zone's sensor stops reporting, the zone's valve closes. Counted from when the sensor is unreachable: an H&T is after 4 hours without reports (it normally reports at least every 2 hours). Not the Shelly's 15-minute timer, which closes the valve if the board stops.
climate_admin.setting_sensor_failsafe_example: With {hours}: the valve closes about {total} hours after the H&T's last report.
climate_admin.settings_fixed: Fixed, not changed from here: zone valves are sent 'on for 15 minutes', renewed every 5, the dehumidifier 'for 8' - if the board stops, the Shelly switches them off by itself, the dehumidifier always before its water (see the guide under Devices); each Shelly is checked every 5 minutes, and at once when it's back online; the H&Ts report when the temperature changes by 0.5 °C (an H&T setting) and at least every 2 hours anyway.
climate_admin.setting_history_retention_days_help: Older data is deleted every day.
climate_admin.setting_history_max_db_mb_help: Hard ceiling on the history database: over it, the oldest days are deleted.
climate_admin.setting_history_disk: At most {max} MB on this disk ({total} GB, {free} GB free): the history takes a tenth of it at most, leaving room for a backup and the system.
climate_admin.setting_history_capped: The value in force, {value} MB, is more than the disk allows: {max} MB is used.
climate_admin.guide_step1: Pick heating or cooling: it applies to the whole plant, and each has its own schedule (painted from the dashboard).
climate_admin.guide_step2: Enter each Shelly's id - every zone's sensor and valve, the bypass, the dehumidifier, the outdoor sensor, the VMC - and save. The id is shown in the Shelly app.
climate_admin.guide_step3: Devices and settings apply after 'Restart LocalHome': the button appears after every save.
climate_admin.guide_step4: Every card says whether its device answers; the overview at the top sums it all up and System status has the details.
climate_admin.vmc_program_moved: The VMC's program is picked on the home page, on its card.
climate_admin.system_problem_device_not_heard_yet: {subject}: not heard yet since the board came up - battery sensors report every couple of hours
climate_admin.setting_site_name_help: The dashboard's heading and the name under the icon on a phone. Applies on reload, no restart.
climate_admin.settings_saved_live: Saved. Reload the page to see the new name.
climate_admin.zones_fresh_note: On a new installation the zones are Stanze and Bagni, every Shelly to configure. Once a device is installed, enter its id and save - one at a time is fine. To try it without devices, choose "Simulated".
climate_admin.setting_history_now: Now: {used} MB of {max} ({percent}%), {rows} readings from {sensors} sensors, since {since}.
climate_admin.setting_history_contents: It holds device readings only ({fields}): schedules, settings and the zone mapping live in their own files and take up nothing here.
climate_admin.setting_history_cap_never: The ceiling has never been reached.
climate_admin.setting_history_disk_hold: Disk almost full since {since}: the history is held at {size} MB, its oldest days making room for new ones until there's space again.
climate_admin.setting_history_cap_hit: Ceiling last reached on {when}: the oldest days were removed.
climate_admin.led_note: The board's LED matrix shows LocalHome's state to whoever is standing in front of the box, without a phone - above all when the network or LocalHome itself isn't working, which is exactly when this page won't open. On every screen the top-right pixel blinks: LocalHome is alive and drawing.
climate_admin.led_status_running: Connected: the matrix shows the state live.
climate_admin.led_status_no_router: This board has no link to a microcontroller (it isn't an Arduino UNO Q, or the arduino-router service is stopped): the matrix stays dark. The mirror below still shows what it would draw.
climate_admin.led_status_no_sketch: LocalHome's sketch isn't loaded on the microcontroller, so the matrix isn't showing the state. It's loaded once, from the board, with arduino-cli - after installing the Arduino_RouterBridge library if it isn't there yet: every command is in step 11 of the quick installation guide (docs/quick-installation-arduino-uno-q.md). No LocalHome restart needed.
climate_admin.led_status_error: Couldn't talk to the microcontroller: {error}. Retrying by itself every 30 seconds.
climate_admin.led_now_boot: Start-up: the board's IP address, {ip}, scrolling by.
climate_admin.led_legend_heat: Flame: heating season. The two bars on the right are zone 1 and zone 2: full = valve open, dim = closed, just the base = a valve that hasn't answered yet.
climate_admin.led_legend_cool: Snowflake: cooling season. Zone bars as above.
climate_admin.led_legend_away: House: away mode on, valves closed until you're back.
climate_admin.led_legend_diagnostic: Wrench: the thermostat isn't driving the valves; they're switched by hand from this panel.
climate_admin.led_legend_idle: Dash: no zone has been configured yet.
climate_admin.led_legend_problem: A blinking exclamation mark and a two-character code (see the table below). With more than one problem they take turns, with the normal screen in between.
climate_admin.led_legend_boot: When LocalHome starts, after the name the board's IP address scrolls by once - for when its .local name doesn't answer.
climate_admin.led_legend_silence: Blinking X: the microcontroller hasn't heard anything for 20 seconds. LocalHome has stopped, hung or is restarting - if it lasts more than a minute, restart the board.
climate_admin.led_legend_waiting: A dot running along the bottom: the board is on but LocalHome hasn't started yet (the first seconds after power-up).
climate_admin.led_code_DV: another device isn't answering - the system status says which
climate_admin.led_code_MQ: the MQTT broker can't be reached: no Shelly device can talk to LocalHome
climate_admin.led_code_CF: a configured device didn't load (a configuration error)
climate_admin.led_code_LP: a control loop has stopped (thermostat or history)
climate_admin.led_code_CK: the board's clock isn't synchronized with the internet: schedules may be off
climate_admin.settings_not_a_number: {label}: that isn't a valid number. Correct it, or empty the field to go back to the default.
climate_admin.settings_out_of_range: {label}: the value must be between {min} and {max}.
climate_admin.manual_temp_range: The temperature must be between -30 and 60 °C.
climate_admin.manual_humidity_range: The humidity must be between 0 and 100 %.
climate_admin.zones_note_more: Simulated means hardware not installed yet; manual, a value typed by hand for testing. The status in the cards is what's running. Switching from "Shelly" to another source only stops talking to that device: nothing is ever sent to it. A simulated valve can still be tested, opened and closed by hand from Diagnostic mode too, before a real relay is wired. A card saying "saved, but not running yet" needs a restart before its status tells you anything useful.
climate_admin.diagnostic_note_more: It covers both zones' valves and the extra switches that are wired (bathroom bypass, dehumidifier). While it's on no interlock or season switch touches them, not even to force a safe state: every valve stays where you left it, or where its last command before it was turned on left it.
climate_admin.group_plant_note: Season, zones and tuning: how the home is heated and cooled.
climate_admin.group_devices_note: Every device with its state, and the ones connected from here.
climate_admin.devices_note: Everything LocalHome reads or drives, those not answering first. OK: it works. Amber: something to do - the label says what. Not answering: it can't be reached. A power cut or a restart asked for is only noted, never a fault. A Shelly opens to what it says about itself.
climate_admin.devices_setup_note: Source and ID of the ones that don't belong to a zone (a zone's are under Zones). A save needs a restart.
climate_admin.group_board_note: The board running LocalHome: health, LED matrix and settings.
climate_admin.group_tools_note: Rarely needed: testing valves and relays, backups and resets.
climate_admin.restart_bar: Saved changes that take effect after a restart: {what}.
climate_admin.diagnostic_alert: Diagnostic mode is on: the thermostat and the safety rules are stopped, valves move only by hand.
climate_admin.broker_none: No broker: there's no config/mqtt_broker.json. Only needed with real Shellys - see docs/integrations/mqtt.md.
climate_admin.rules_note: Always on or off: LocalHome drives it. Your choice: you switch it from the home page. Applies at once.
climate_admin.rules_saved: Rules saved: they apply at once.
climate_admin.rule_in_config: Rule written in config.yaml: change it there.
climate_admin.rule_not_wired: Not connected: the rule applies once its ID is entered in Extra switches.
climate_admin.led_legend_name: The page's name scrolls by at start-up and then every 5 minutes, when there's no problem to show: which board this is, at a glance.
climate_admin.diagnostics_note: One file with a summary to read first (how long the board has been on, the Wi-Fi, the devices, what the watchdogs did), then the status, recent logs, the watchdog history and the configuration (no passwords): to send to whoever looks after the installation.
climate_admin.protection_memory_limit: Restarted if LocalHome grows past 512 MB
climate_admin.wd_memory: LocalHome past its memory limit: restarted
climate_admin.system_problem_protection_missing: Protection not on: {subject} - run sudo sh deploy/tune-board.sh
climate_admin.watchdog_note: What the watchdogs did, the last 10 times: the Wi-Fi one, the one that restarts LocalHome and the Shellys' safety timer. Every other time is in the Download diagnostics file; the board's unexpected reboots are under Recent board boots.
climate_admin.watchdog_none: Nothing so far: it hasn't been needed.
climate_admin.wd_radio_on: The Wi-Fi radio was off: switched back on
climate_admin.wd_profile_fixed: Wi-Fi network "{all}": reconnects for ever, power saving off
climate_admin.wd_reconnect: No network for {a} min: reconnecting the Wi-Fi
climate_admin.wd_nm_restart: No network for {a} min: restarting the network manager
climate_admin.wd_reboot: No network for {a} min: rebooting the board
climate_admin.wd_reboot_skipped: No network for {a} min: no reboot (already rebooted less than 6 hours ago)
climate_admin.wd_unhealthy: LocalHome not answering or a control loop stuck: it's restarted if this lasts
climate_admin.wd_healthy: LocalHome fine again, no restart needed
climate_admin.wd_killed: LocalHome hung for 2 minutes: restarted by the watchdog
climate_admin.wd_boot_reconnect: Wi-Fi reconnected once after start-up (normal, a precaution)
climate_admin.system_problem_lan_unreachable: The Shelly devices haven't reached the board for {subject}, although the board is on and connected to the Wi-Fi: almost certainly the router. Restart the router.
climate_admin.led_code_RT: the devices can't reach the board although it's on the Wi-Fi: restart the router
climate_admin.wd_lan_silent: No Shelly connected for {a} min although the router answers: Wi-Fi reconnected (if that's not enough, restart the router)
climate_admin.wd_lan_back: The Shellys reach the board again

climate_admin.shelly_note: What each Shelly says about itself: signal, temperature, restarts, firmware and, for battery ones, whether their reports arrive on time. Read only.
climate_admin.shelly_note_more: Battery sensors sleep: they're read when they wake (at least every 2 hours, or when temperature and humidity change). Mains-powered ones are asked every 5 minutes. Signal: above -65 dBm excellent, down to -75 good, down to -85 weak but usable, below that critical.
climate_admin.shelly_reports_usb: {count} (on USB-C, it says it wakes every {period})
climate_admin.device_why_report_late_period: Nothing from it for {detail}, while it says it wakes every {period}: check its power and its Wi-Fi.
climate_admin.device_why_report_late: Nothing from it for {detail}: a battery H&T reports at least every 2 hours. Press its button; if it doesn't answer, check its battery and signal.
climate_admin.device_why_battery_low: Battery at {detail}%: to be changed soon.
climate_admin.device_why_reports_missed: {detail} reports lost in the last 24 hours: usually a weak signal or the battery.
climate_admin.device_why_settings: Shelly settings to fix in the Shelly app ({detail}): which ones and how is below.
climate_admin.device_why_restart_required: The Shelly asks for a restart to apply an update or a setting: restart it from the Shelly app.
climate_admin.device_why_hot: Inside at {detail} °C: at about 90 °C it switches itself off. Check its box isn't closed or near something hot.
climate_admin.device_why_short_cycling: Its relay switched on {detail} times in 24 hours: too many for a radiant panel valve (a hysteresis too narrow, a sensor jumping, or something else switching it).
climate_admin.device_why_crashes: It crashed and restarted by itself {detail} times in 7 days (a firmware fault or a watchdog): update its firmware; if it keeps on, replace it.
climate_admin.device_why_crashes_one: It crashed and restarted by itself once in the last 7 days (a firmware fault or a watchdog): update its firmware; if it happens again, replace it.
climate_admin.device_why_power_unstable: It restarted {detail} times in 7 days because its supply dipped: check its power and wiring.
climate_admin.device_why_power_unstable_one: It restarted once in 7 days because its supply dipped: check its power and wiring.
climate_admin.device_note_power_cuts: It was without power {count} times in 7 days, the last on {when}: unplugged, a breaker or a blackout. Not a fault.
climate_admin.device_note_power_cuts_one: It was without power once in 7 days, on {when}: unplugged, a breaker or a blackout. Not a fault.
climate_admin.device_note_restarts_unknown: {count} restarts nobody asked for in 7 days, from before LocalHome recorded why: not a fault in themselves.
climate_admin.device_note_restarts_unknown_one: 1 restart nobody asked for in 7 days, from before LocalHome recorded why: not a fault in itself.
climate_admin.device_note_restarts_wanted: {count} restarts asked for in 7 days: updates, settings, restarts from the app.
climate_admin.device_note_power_switched: It went from powered to its batteries on {when}: it works the same, now at a battery's rhythm.
climate_admin.device_note_restarts_wanted_one: 1 restart asked for in 7 days: an update, a setting or a restart from the app.
climate_admin.device_note_weak_signal: Weak signal: {avg} dBm on average over the last 24 hours. Fine as long as it answers and its reports arrive.
climate_admin.system_problem_device_crashes: {subject}: crashed and restarted by itself - update its firmware
climate_admin.system_problem_device_power_unstable: {subject}: restarts from a dip in its supply - check its power and wiring
climate_admin.system_problem_device_restart_required: {subject}: asks for a restart from the Shelly app
climate_admin.system_problem_device_hot: {subject} very hot: check its box isn't sealed or near a heat source
climate_admin.system_problem_relay_short_cycling: {subject}: its relay switched on too many times in the last 24 hours - openings too short (a hysteresis too narrow, a sensor jumping) or something else switching it
climate_admin.system_problem_device_reports_missed: {subject}: reports lost over the last 24 hours (weak signal or battery)
climate_admin.system_problem_shelly_settings: {subject}: Shelly settings to fix in its app (Devices says which and how)
climate_admin.system_recent_safety_timer: {subject}: the Shelly's safety timer kicked in - LocalHome hadn't renewed the command for 15 minutes (board or LocalHome stopped, or network down)
climate_admin.check_bad_id: This can't be a Shelly's id or MQTT prefix: no spaces, /, + or #.
climate_admin.check_battery: A battery sensor: it sleeps and can't be asked. Press its button: once it wakes it shows under Devices.
climate_admin.check_no_broker: No MQTT broker: config/mqtt_broker.json is missing.
climate_admin.check_silent: Not answering: check the id, and that it's on, on the Wi-Fi, with MQTT pointed at this board (see the guide under Devices).
climate_admin.check_silent_prefix: No answer. The id is the model, a dash and the 12 characters of its MAC (e.g. shellyplus1-c0ffee000001); if you changed the MQTT prefix in the Shelly app, type that here. Check it's also on, on the Wi-Fi, with MQTT to this board.
climate_admin.check_settings_unread: Couldn't read its settings: try again.
climate_admin.check_fix: To fix in the Shelly app - {settings}.
climate_admin.guide_plus1: How the plant works, wiring and setting up the Shellys, what happens when something is missing, and how to read the device status: the administrator's guide, in Italian.
climate_admin.guide_more: How the software and the plant work, wiring, the Shellys' settings and what to do when something's missing: the
climate_admin.guide_button_title: The administrator's guide: how the software and the plant work, the Shellys, what to do when something's missing
climate_admin.vmc_speeds_note: The five levels' percentages: the home page's buttons and its slider (which starts at the minimum), the programs, "Boost for", "Guests", the automatics and away. In use at once, a running program too.
climate_admin.vmc_auto_reference_help: The room the summer and winter automatics go by: by default the first zone cooled.
climate_admin.vmc_auto_winter_help: Only in the winter season, on the reference room.
climate_admin.vmc_auto_dry_help: In winter the outdoor air is very dry: ventilating hard takes a house below 35-40% humidity (dry throat, static, wood shrinking). When the reference room's humidity goes under the threshold, the VMC goes to Night; back as before when it is 3 points up again. With the outdoor sensor, only if the outdoor air is really drier (a lower dew point than indoors): on a mild, humid day ventilating doesn't dry the house, and the VMC is left as it is.
climate_admin.vmc_auto_now_dry: Under way: dry air in {zone}, humidity {rh}% → {value}%
climate_admin.vmc_filters_note: The reminder to clean the filters: a Maico AERA 320's manual asks for the unit's and the vents' at least every 3 months (guide, section 4). The home page warns 14 days before, and "Cleaned today" can be said from there.
climate_admin.vmc_filters_never: No cleaning recorded yet: no reminder until one is.
climate_admin.vmc_filters_cleaned_done: Marked cleaned today: the reminder starts over.
climate_admin.vmc_auto_note: The VMC can change speed by itself in three cases, on top of its program and of a speed picked by hand. Off by default: each is switched on by itself, the recommended values ready. They never switch the VMC on when it's off; a speed picked by hand while one is under way wins until its reason has passed. In use at once.
climate_admin.vmc_auto_shower_help: A shower takes a bathroom's humidity from 50-60% to 80-90% in a few minutes: the rise counts, not a fixed value, which would fire all summer. Boost by day, Day in the quiet hours. Made for the H&Ts' humidity threshold at 1%, as in the guide.
climate_admin.vmc_auto_quiet_help: In these hours the automatics never use Boost: it's loud.
climate_admin.vmc_auto_summer_help: Only in the summer season, comparing the reference room with the outdoor sensor.
climate_admin.vmc_auto_humid_help: When the outdoor air holds more water than the indoor, every cubic metre let in brings humidity: the VMC goes to Night, the least that still ventilates. Dew points are compared, not relative humidity.
climate_admin.vmc_auto_cooling_help: A warm house, cool outdoor air no more humid: the VMC goes to Day, never Boost. It needs the VMC's summer bypass: a Maico AERA 320 opens it by itself with more than 22 °C inside, warmer inside than out and more than 16 °C outside. Below that the air goes through the heat exchanger and doesn't cool.
climate_admin.vmc_auto_speed_shower: If slower: {boost}. In the quiet hours: {day}.
climate_admin.vmc_auto_needs_outdoor: Needs the outdoor sensor: connect it in Devices.
climate_admin.vmc_auto_now_none: No automatic change under way now.
climate_admin.vmc_auto_now_humid: Under way: more humid outside (dew point {out}° against {in}°) → {value}%
climate_admin.extra_bypass_normally_open: Normally open valve: its Shelly on closes it
climate_admin.extra_dehumidifier_zone: Draws its water through the zone's valve
climate_admin.extra_dehumidifier_zone_hint: While the dehumidifier is on (in summer) this zone's valve stays open, even if the zone sits out the cooling.
climate_admin.link_off_season: Out of season: the valve follows the temperature

errors.vmc_no_target: Choose which device the program controls before turning it on.
